import numpy as np
from scipy.optimize import least_squares
t,x,v,a=df['t'].values,df['x'].values,df['v'].values,df['dv_dt'].values
def model(p):
    w=p[0]; lam=p[13]
    base=p[1]+p[2]*x+p[3]*v+p[4]*v**2+p[5]*np.sin(v)+p[6]*np.sin(x)
    E=np.exp(-lam*t)
    return base+(p[7]+p[8]*x+p[9]*v)*np.cos(w*t)+(p[10]+p[11]*x+p[12]*v)*np.sin(w*t)+E*(p[14]+p[15]*x+p[16]*v)
rng=np.random.default_rng(2)
best=(1e9,None)
for k in range(150):
    p0=np.concatenate([[rng.uniform(0.2,4)],rng.normal(0,1,12),[rng.uniform(0.05,2)],rng.normal(0,1,3)])
    with np.errstate(all='ignore'):
        try:
            r=least_squares(lambda p: np.nan_to_num(model(p)-a,nan=1e6,posinf=1e6,neginf=-1e6),p0,max_nfev=1500)
            n=np.mean(r.fun**2)/np.var(a)
            if np.isfinite(n) and n<best[0]: best=(n,r.x)
        except Exception as e: pass
print('nmse',best[0]); print(np.round(best[1],4) if best[1] is not None else None)
